seeds.text: The shaking, crying, trembling — that's the body finally finishing the survival response it couldn't complete in the moment.
Your personality may be the mask your nervous system built to stay safe. Stripping it isn't the goal — knowing it is.
Trauma doesn't start with you. It moves through bloodlines, bodies, and cultures — you may be holding what isn't yours.
Your nervous system isn't broken. It's doing exactly what it was built to do — by an environment you didn't pick.
Safety isn't a thought. Your nervous system reads the room and decides — before any conscious belief.

slides.composition: A luminous, glitching chrome heart, slightly fragmented, floating centrally in a deep navy and starfield black cosmic void, with subtle rainbow chromatic aberration around its edges.

slides.text: It's doing exactly what it learned to survive.
slides.composition: An ornate, tribal chrome mask, partially obscured by soft, swirling pastel pink and sky blue clouds, positioned in a medium close-up, gazing out with a stoic, reflective quality.

slides.text: Safety isn't a choice. Your gut knows before your mind does.
slides.composition: A top-down overhead view of liquid silver ripples expanding outwards on a reflective surface, mirroring a distant, amber and violet painterly sky with a single, small glowing orb at its center.

slides.text: That anxious twitch, that freeze: the energy of an old threat.
slides.composition: A close-up of a single, highly detailed 90s cel-shaded anime hand, slightly trembling with subtle VHS lines, reaching towards a distant, shimmering lens flare against a dark background.

slides.text: Even your 'personality' might be a survival strategy.
slides.composition: A full-body chrome figure, posed defensively with arms crossed, standing small against a vast, abstract cosmic field of shifting nebulae and prismatic light bursts, suggesting deep space.

slides.text: It's not a flaw. It's your system trying to protect you.
slides.composition: A shimmering, almost liquid-metal archway or portal, softly glowing with gold sparkle, framing a serene view of a pastel pink and cloud-filled sky, seen from a slight distance.

slides.text: You can learn to listen to its story.
slides.composition: A close-up of a pair of glossy, metallic hands gently cradling a delicate, softly pulsing iridescent sphere that radiates a warm, subtle glow.

caption:
Feeling like your body is just... against you sometimes? It's not. It's doing exactly what it learned to do to keep you safe. No blame, just understanding. You can start listening differently tonight.
